description: A principal must approve and configure a six-Saturday high-school credit-recovery program, including its delivery setting, enrollment cap, instructor, stipend, and funding documentation, with input from an instructional coach and the school's finance coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school is considering a six-Saturday credit-recovery program for students who need to complete Algebra I.
shared_context.S2: The submitted program request lists 20 seats, proposes use of a regular classroom, and leaves the instructor and funding source pending.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan has final approval authority for the program's format, enrollment, staffing, and funding record.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine approval process includes a short procurement and implementation check with the instructional coach and finance coordinator before the principal signs the request.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's current student confirmations show that exactly 14 students will attend, and each of those students must complete work on the district learning platform during the sessions; the regular classroom has no student computers, while the computer lab has 14 networked workstations. She collected the confirmations this week but has not updated the submitted request.

PF2.text: The award letter for the credit-recovery grant permits only a certified mathematics teacher to lead the sessions and provides exactly $2,400 for this program, calculated as six sessions at a $400 instructor stipend; Mr. Lewis reviewed the award letter this week but has not entered its restrictions in the approval record.

acceptance_conditions: The program must be approved for six sessions.
The program must use the computer lab.
Enrollment must be capped at exactly 14 students.
The instructor must be a certified mathematics teacher.
The instructor stipend must be exactly $400 per session.
The credit-recovery grant must be recorded as the funding source.
An implementation record must document the computer-lab setup and grant restrictions.

content_checks.C4: decisions['delivery_setting'] == 'computer lab' or decisions['delivery_setting'] == 'computer lab with 14 networked workstations'
content_checks.C7: decisions['funding_source'] == 'credit-recovery grant' or decisions['funding_source'] == 'credit-recovery grant ($2,400 total)'
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'implementation_record' or c['type'] == 'record_update' or c['type'] == 'update_request' or c['type'] == 'update_approval_record' or c['type'] == 'funding_record' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed attendance count changes the enrollment cap from the submitted 20 seats to exactly 14, the students' required platform work changes the setting from a regular classroom to the computer lab, and the revised setup must be documented.

The grant award changes staffing to a certified mathematics teacher, sets the stipend at exactly $400 per session, changes the funding source to the credit-recovery grant, and requires its restrictions to be entered in the approval record.
